EXTRA CLASSES

The bonus shelf of the school.

Eight extra classes sit beside the core learning path — never inside it: the regular classes stay the main sequence, and these are a bonus for families who want more. The Nature Club lives just beside the shelf. Skip them freely: no one falls behind.

EXTRA CLASS

The Toddler Room

Thirty-five cards for one- to three-year-olds: the toys, the mealtimes, the sleep corner and the care routines of the toddler room, each with an age pill and its own lesson.

Visit the Toddler Room ↗EXTRA CLASS

Kitchen Helper

Thirty-five kitchen cards with age pills — everyday things, helper tools, grown-up tools and the one rule card: knives are for grown-ups. Lessons teach the hot-don’t-touch crew too.

Visit the Kitchen ↗EXTRA CLASS

Doctor Visit

Twenty-two doctor-visit cards in visit order for ages 3–5 — a teddy bear on every step of a check-up, from the appointment to the proud goodbye. Lessons walk the visit step by step; the one rule said kindly: medicine is only taken from a grown-up.

Take the Doctor Visit ↗EXTRA CLASS

Home and Daily Life

Forty-one cards for the words of home — rooms and furniture, wash-and-bedtime routines, kitchen actions, chores and tools, the door, the sounds and the green habits. Lessons walk the real house; US and UK words ride together: tap and faucet, torch and flashlight, trolley and cart.

Walk through the home ↗EXTRA CLASS

Kids Games

Twenty-six classic games with a simple how-to-play guide a kid can follow — balloons and beanbags, hiding and hopping, boards, mazes and treasure maps — with US/UK names taught side by side.

Open the games ↗EXTRA CLASS

Places in the Community

Twenty-eight places a town is made of, each with a simple lesson a kid can follow — the library, the fire station, the bakery, the bus stop, the park and the zoo — with US/UK names taught side by side.

Walk the town ↗EXTRA CLASS

Animal Categories

Twenty-four animal families on spotter sheets — pets and farm friends, the crawly crews, feathers, fins and scales, the big wild ones, four habitats, dinosaurs and the giants of the ocean — each with a simple lesson a kid can follow. The sorting class: ninety-six labeled animals, one deck.

Sort the animals ↗EXTRA CLASS

Colors

Fifteen color spotter sheets for ages 2–5 — the eleven first colors, red to gold, each a two-by-two sheet of four labeled things, then four make-it-yourself shades for ages 4–5 with their mixing recipes. Sixty labeled pictures, every card with its own lesson.

Hunt the colors ↗

Every extra class keeps its own card set in the flashcards library — the Toddler Room cards on the toddler shelf, and the Kitchen, Doctor Visit, Home and Daily Life, Kids Games, Places in the Community, Animal Categories and Colors cards on the Ages 4–5 shelf, with the Nature Club Animals cards beside them — and every card opens its own lesson inside the class. The core Learning Path runs its own sequence, untouched.
